title: Avoid Flood in The City
description: Given rains as an array where rains[i] > 0 means lake rains[i] fills, and rains[i] == 0 means you can dry one lake, determine if you can avoid floods.
pseudocode:
1. map = {}, zeros = []
2. for i, lake in rains:
3.   if lake > 0:
4.     if lake in map: dry_day = zeros.find(> map[lake])
5.     if dry_day: ans[dry_day] = lake, map[lake] = i
6.     else: return []
7.   else: zeros.push(i), ans[i] = 1
8. return ans

steps.note: Lake 1 is full, mark in map
Processing 0 at index 2, add to zeros stack
Lake 1 rains again at index 3. Need to dry using a zero after index 0
Dry lake 1 using zero at index 2
